page.notes: Printed "s" and "ss" forms read as plain s throughout, e.g. "verissimum", "sublataq;", "descensu". Abbreviation punctuation such as "1.Corinth,7." and "cap.51.&Petrus" is copied as printed. The dash-like underline below the last line is not text and is left out.
